methods.decaySharp: decaySharp() { const s = this._sharp; if (!s) return; for (const k in s) { s[k] = Math.round((s[k] - 0.025) * 1000) / 1000; if (s[k] <= 0) delete s[k]; } }
methods.momentumMod: momentumMod() { const n = this._combo || 0; return Math.min(0.10, Math.max(0, (Math.min(n, 5) - 1) * 0.025)); }
methods.momentumSkew: momentumSkew() { const n = this._combo || 0; return Math.min(0.40, Math.max(0, (Math.min(n, 5) - 1) * 0.10)); }
methods.cardStage: cardStage(key, q) { const s = this.stage && this.stage[key]; return (s && s[this.qhash(q)]) || 0; }
methods._deckCardCount: _deckCardCount(d) { const c = this._cardsOf(d); return c ? c.length : ((d && d.n) || 0); }
